scope: Official Local:Thrive preset listing demo inspected read-only through rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper interactions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Local:Thrive preset listing View demo opened Local Theme Thrive.

claims.observed: Home combines category/product shelves with benefit-led category modules and product education; collection exposes benefits/availability/price facets and sorting; PDP surfaces variant links, quantity, pickup details, collapsible product content and a complementary product.
claims.risk: Rendered labels establish page content and affordances only; no filtering, sorting, selection, pickup lookup or recommendation action was executed.
claims.vsn_guard: Keep category discovery understandable and test facet semantics, variant selection, pickup availability and recommendation relevance against real catalog data.

claims.observed: Demo pages show mushroom/ingredient efficacy, reviews, sales-volume, discount, pickup, and money-back guarantee copy.
claims.risk: These are merchant-provided demonstration claims and were not independently verified.
claims.vsn_guard: Substantiate health and efficacy statements, review counts, prices, stock, pickup data and guarantee terms before displaying them.
